```yaml
name: Regenerate Examples and Safety Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'tokf-filter/examples.rs'
      - 'tokf-common/safety/**'
      - 'tokf-cli/src/verify.rs'
      - 'tokf-server/src/**'
      - 'tokf-server/migrations/**'
      - 'tokf-common/lib.rs'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/regenerate-examples.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'tokf-filter/examples.rs'
      - 'tokf-common/safety/**'
      - 'tokf-cli/src/verify.rs'
      - 'tokf-server/src/**'
      - 'tokf-server/migrations/**'
      - 'tokf-common/lib.rs'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/regenerate-examples.yml'

jobs:
  regenerate-examples:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libclang-dev
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Run example generation
        run: |
          cargo run --package tokf-filter --bin generate-examples
          
      - name: Verify examples.json exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "examples.json" ]; then
            echo "examples.json not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
      - name: Run safety checks
        run: |
          cargo run --package tokf-cli --bin tokf verify --safety --json
          
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace
          
      - name: Run clippy
        run: |
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
          
      - name: Check formatting
        run: |
          cargo fmt -- --check
          
      - name: Run DB integration tests
        run: |
          just test-db
          
      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          just test-e2e
          
      - name: Upload examples.json
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: examples-json
          path: examples.json
          retention-days: 7
          
      - name: Upload safety report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: safety-report
          path: safety-report.json
          retention-days: 7
```
